message:
I've been thinking about how much we rely on our phones and gadgets these days, especially when it comes to staying prepared. But what happens when the battery dies or the signal drops at the worst possible moment? That's why I love resources that help us teach our little ones about being ready, even without tech. 

It's all about building those important skills and knowledge that will stick with them for life. After all, preparedness isn’t just about what we can access at the tap of a finger; it’s about being ready in any situation. Have you talked with your grandkids about how to stay prepared?
